bg.$description: color used by the list component for background.

padding.$description: dimension used by the list component for padding.

gap.$description: dimension used by the list component for gap (MarsUI compositions stack rows contiguously; --ki-list-gap stays as the theme hook).

min-height.$description: dimension used by the list component for item min height (MarsUI md text-only row is ~40px content-sized: 20px line + 2x10 padding).

min-height-multiline.$description: dimension used by the list component for multiline item min height (MarsUI md two-line row measures 56px).

padding-inline.$description: dimension used by the list component for item padding inline.

padding-block.$description: dimension used by the list component for item padding block (MarsUI md rows: Space/lg 10px).

gap.$description: dimension used by the list component for item gap (MarsUI md/lg rows: Space/xl 12px between start/content/end regions).

radius.$description: dimension used by the list component for item radius.

divider-width.$description: dimension used by the list component for item divider width (no divider renders in any master variant; the color hook ki.list.item.divider-color stays so consumers can opt hairlines back in).

divider-color.$description: color used by the list component for item divider color.

primary-font-size.$description: dimension used by the list component for item primary font size.

primary-line-height.$description: dimension used by the list component for primary line height (MarsUI primary is UI/Para/medium 13/20, not UI/Body 1 13/24).

primary-font-weight.$description: font weight used by the list component for item primary font weight.

primary-fg.$description: color used by the list component for item primary foreground.

secondary-font-size.$description: dimension used by the list component for secondary font size (MarsUI description line is UI/Caption 2: 12px).

secondary-line-height.$description: dimension used by the list component for secondary line height (MarsUI caption_2 16px; same value as before with the correct provenance).

secondary-font-weight.$description: font weight used by the list component for item secondary font weight.

secondary-fg.$description: color used by the list component for item secondary foreground.

min-height.$description: dimension used by the list component for the sm one-line item min height (two List 10063:2066 sm block paddings plus the primary line: 32px).

min-height-multiline.$description: dimension used by the list component for the sm two-line item min height (List 10063:2066 sm measures 48px).

padding-inline.$description: dimension used by the list component for sm item padding inline (List 10063:2066 sm binds Space/md, 8px).

padding-block.$description: dimension used by the list component for sm item padding block (List 10063:2066 sm binds Space/sm, 6px).

gap.$description: dimension used by the list component for sm item gap (List 10063:2066 sm binds Space/lg, 10px).

primary-font-size.$description: dimension used by the list component for sm primary font size (List 10063:2066 sm primary: UI/para).

primary-line-height.$description: dimension used by the list component for sm primary line height (List 10063:2066 sm).

secondary-font-size.$description: dimension used by the list component for sm secondary font size (List 10063:2066 sm description: UI/caption-2).

secondary-line-height.$description: dimension used by the list component for sm secondary line height (List 10063:2066 sm).

min-height.$description: dimension used by the list component for the lg one-line item min height (two List 10063:2066 lg block paddings plus the primary line: 48px).

min-height-multiline.$description: dimension used by the list component for the lg two-line item min height (List 10063:2066 lg measures 64px).

padding-inline.$description: dimension used by the list component for lg item padding inline (List 10063:2066 lg binds Space/md, 8px).

padding-block.$description: dimension used by the list component for lg item padding block (List 10063:2066 lg binds Space/xl, 12px).

gap.$description: dimension used by the list component for lg item gap (List 10063:2066 lg binds Space/xl, 12px).

primary-font-size.$description: dimension used by the list component for lg primary font size (List 10063:2066 lg primary: UI/body-2).

primary-line-height.$description: dimension used by the list component for lg primary line height (List 10063:2066 lg).

secondary-font-size.$description: dimension used by the list component for lg secondary font size (List 10063:2066 lg description: UI/caption-2).

secondary-line-height.$description: dimension used by the list component for lg secondary line height (List 10063:2066 lg).

min-height.$description: dimension used by the list component for the xl one-line item min height (two List 10063:2066 xl block paddings plus the primary line: 52px).

min-height-multiline.$description: dimension used by the list component for the xl two-line item min height (List 10063:2066 xl measures 72px).

padding-inline.$description: dimension used by the list component for xl item padding inline (List 10063:2066 xl binds Space/xl, 12px).

padding-block.$description: dimension used by the list component for xl item padding block (List 10063:2066 xl binds Space/2xl, 14px).

gap.$description: dimension used by the list component for xl item gap (List 10063:2066 xl binds Space/3xl, 16px).

primary-font-size.$description: dimension used by the list component for xl primary font size (List 10063:2066 xl primary: UI/title-2).

primary-line-height.$description: dimension used by the list component for xl primary line height (List 10063:2066 xl).

secondary-font-size.$description: dimension used by the list component for xl secondary font size (List 10063:2066 xl description: UI/para).

secondary-line-height.$description: dimension used by the list component for xl secondary line height (List 10063:2066 xl).

hover-bg.$description: Background of an unselected hovered interactive list row.

hover-fg.$description: Text and indicator on an unselected hovered interactive list row.

selected-bg.$description: Background of a selected list option.

selected-fg.$description: Text and indicator on a selected list option.

interactive-bg.$description: Resting fill of an unselected interactive list row.

interactive-bg-image.$description: Optional image layered over interactive list row fills.

interactive-backdrop-filter.$description: Complete backdrop filter for an interactive list row.

interactive-radius.$description: Corner radius of link and option rows.

indicator-size.$description: Edge of the trailing selection or navigation mark.

indicator-border-width.$description: Stroke around a visual option indicator.

checkbox-radius.$description: Corner radius of a multiple-selection indicator.

radio-radius.$description: Corner radius of a single-selection indicator.
